mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ledger_period_balance (id, period_id, ledger_book_id, chart_account_id, opening_balance, period_debit, period_credit, closing_balance, as_of_sequence, trial_balance_run_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.periodId}, #{row.ledgerBookId}, #{row.chartAccountId}, #{row.openingBalance}, #{row.periodDebit}, #{row.periodCredit}, #{row.closingBalance}, #{row.asOfSequence}, #{row.trialBalanceRunId}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime}) AS n ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE opening_balance = IF(n.as_of_sequence >= t_ledger_period_balance.as_of_sequence, n.opening_balance, t_ledger_period_balance.opening_balance), period_debit = IF(n.as_of_sequence >= t_ledger_period_balance.as_of_sequence, n.period_debit, t_ledger_period_balance.period_debit), period_credit = IF(n.as_of_sequence >= t_ledger_period_balance.as_of_sequence, n.period_credit, t_ledger_period_balance.period_credit), closing_balance = IF(n.as_of_sequence >= t_ledger_period_balance.as_of_sequence, n.closing_balance, t_ledger_period_balance.closing_balance), update_time = IF(n.as_of_sequence >= t_ledger_period_balance.as_of_sequence, n.update_time, t_ledger_period_balance.update_time), trial_balance_run_id = IF(n.as_of_sequence >= t_ledger_period_balance.as_of_sequence, n.trial_balance_run_id, t_ledger_period_balance.trial_balance_run_id), as_of_sequence = GREATEST(t_ledger_period_balance.as_of_sequence, n.as_of_sequence)
